- Spring-loaded mechanism that stores kinetic energy and releases with a trigger press.
- "Clean" cap ejection claimed to occur in one motion. The planned demonstration video is intended to visually clarify this feature.
- Emphasis on long-lasting performance through durable materials.
- Engineered with impact resistance in mind due to repeated contact from a spring-driven bolt.
- To visually support claims of longevity, we plan to conduct and share results from a small, informal durability test. We propose filming a stress test that cycles the opener 500 times.
- Positioned as both functional tool and display-worthy object or gift.
- To refine the final product, we propose offering a planned, small-batch pre-production run to a select group of backers for early feedback before full manufacturing commences.
